rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance rent ceiling / Annual General Adjustment capped at 5% (Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Fully covered rental units have a rent ceiling. Rent increases are limited to the Annual General Adjustment (AGA), which the Rent Board sets each year using a CPI-based formula. Measure BB caps the AGA at 5% even if the formula yields more. Landlords with banked (unused) prior AGAs may still raise rent by more than 5% to reach the rent ceiling. Owners may petition for increases only for completed capital improvements, not planned ones. Government-owned or subsidized units now become fully or partially covered.
rules.key_value: AGA capped at a maximum of 5% per year (fully covered units)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to fully covered units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, plus some older single-family tenancies and room rentals. New construction (certificate of occupancy issued after 1980), most single-family homes and most condominiums are only partially covered, with no rent ceiling.
rules.exemptions: New construction with a certificate of occupancy after 1980, most single-family homes and most condominiums are partially covered (no rent ceiling). Units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy. Section 202/811 units and certain HUD-insured project-based subsidy units are partially covered regardless of unit type.
rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (as amended by Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.conflict_note: The page says Measure BB passed in the November 2024 election but gives no effective date; December 20, 2024 appears only as the start date for the notice requirement. The coverage cutoff is ambiguous: the page says 'built before 1980' for fully covered units but 'certificate of occupancy issued after 1980' for new construction. The 1980-12-31 cutoff follows the latter, and the exact ordinance date is not stated.

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance just cause for eviction (as amended by Measure BB)
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered units cannot be evicted without just cause. Measure BB changes: (1) eviction for nonpayment is allowed only when rental debt is at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for an equivalent unit (Oakland-Fremont HUD Metro FMR); (2) no eviction for failing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires; (3) lease-breach evictions require a mutually agreed material term, substantial actual damage to the landlord, unreasonable tenant behavior, and a detailed notice to cease; (4) termination notices must include Rent Board advice information; (5) copies of notices and summons/complaints must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of service; (6) owner move-in relocation assistance must be adjusted for inflation each year.
rules.key_value: Just cause required for fully and partially covered units; nonpayment eviction only if debt is at least 1 month of HUD Fair Market Rent; notices filed with Rent Board within 3 business days
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance, including new construction (partially covered).
rules.exemptions: Units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (as amended by Measure BB, Nov. 2024)
